title: RBACv2 changefeed reconciliation + SAML audit enrichment and retention runbook
creator: Jordan Patel
description: Background: Over the last quarter we've observed intermittent differences between the RBAC v2 changefeed and the audit event stream: role grants/revokes sometimes appear in the changefeed but are missing or truncated in long-term audit storage. Separately, SAML-based admin sessions lack assertion-level identifiers in the audit trail, which complicates reconstruction for high-privilege actions. This ticket scopes a three-part remediation: (1) implement a reconciliation job that compares RBAC v2 changefeed events to the audit index and surfaces missing events, (2) enrich SAML authentication logs with assertion_id and recipient fields to make admin session linkage deterministic, and (3) define and implement an admin-event retention and cold-store policy to preserve high-sensitivity records beyond the default sampling window.
acceptance_criteria: A scheduled reconciliation job runs hourly and reports reconciliation delta metric (events_missing / events_seen) to the auth-observability dashboard
SAML auth events in the audit index include assertion_id and recipient fields for 99% of new SAML logins within 24 hours of rollout
Defined retention policy class 'admin_high_precision' implemented: 180 days hot storage, 3 years cold storage (compressed), with auditability via retention-index metadata
Runbook updated and validated: on-call engineer can use the playbook to find missing RBAC changes, kick off reingest, and verify successful audit indexing within 2 hours
No increase in PagerDuty P0 incidents attributable to alert noise after alert tuning (false-positive rate < 5% in first 2 weeks)
notes: 2026-03-05: Initial ticket created after ops reported a customer query where a grant change was visible in the changefeed but absent in ElasticSearch audit index.

2026-03-06: Investigation found three root causes under review: (a) transient backpressure in the audit-ingester causing skippable batches, (b) sampling logic excluding repetitive admin grants, (c) SAML assertion ID not propagated from IDP connector to audit envelope.

2026-03-08: Prototype reconciliation job implemented in staging (python lambda). Verified it can detect missing events and generate reingest batches. Preliminary metric pipeline added to auth-observability Prometheus job 'rbac_changefeed_reconcile'.

2026-03-09: Design review with security and compliance. Agreement to treat admin grants as high-fidelity events (no sampling) and to add assertion-level enrichment. Security requested threat model update and data retention justification for long-term storage.
2026-03-11: PR created for SAML assertion propagation (github.com/redwood-inference/auth-connectors/pull/417). Also created draft retention policy doc in Confluence.
2026-03-12: On-call playbook drafted; still requires end-to-end verification in preprod and sign-off from Legal for 3-year cold storage.
2026-03-12: Noted risk: cold storage increases cost; Optimize team to provide cost delta and potential compression/aggregation knobs.
2026-03-12: Assigned follow-ups: Maya to shepherd retention sign-off and runbook validation; DevEx to add a dashboard widget and a facet for assertion_id queries.
remediation_plan: Step 1: Stabilize audit-ingester: add backpressure metrics and retry + idempotency for out-of-order changefeed messages (ENG-36221 will track code changes).
Step 2: Reconciliation job: deploy hourly job that cross-checks changefeed events against audit index (staging -> preprod -> prod rollout). Job outputs a reingest manifest when delta > 0.5%.
Step 3: SAML enrichment: add assertion_id and recipient fields at IDP connector boundary, propagate through auth pipeline, and include in audit envelope and ChangeDataCapture fields.

Step 4: Retention class: create 'admin_high_precision' policy with metadata tagging at write time; implement cold-store lifecycle (S3 Glacier / equivalent) and retention-index entries for searchability.

Step 5: Alerting and SLO adjustment: add reconciliation-success rate SLO (99.9% hourly) and tune alerts to aggregate deltas before paging (create slack-warning at 5% delta, page at 10% sustained for 1 hour).
Step 6: Runbook & verification: update runbook with playbook steps, reingest commands, and verification queries; run two validation incidents in preprod within the same week before full prod rollout.
rollout_plan: Week 1 (staging): Deploy reconciliation job and expose metrics, run without reingest to collect baseline deltas.
Week 2 (preprod): Enable SAML enrichment and run reconciliation in dry-run mode; verify assertion_id appears with admin sessions and dashboards return correct links.
Week 3 (pilot prod): Enable reingest for a single non-critical org, validate full roundtrip and index verification within 2 hours.
Week 4 (prod): Gradual rollout to all orgs; enable retention tagging. Monitor cost and alert noise; freeze rollout if delta > 1% or legal signoff pending.
Fallback: Disable reingest and revert enrichment via feature flag; reconciliation job remains read-only until issue resolved.
verification_steps: Query dashboard 'rbac_changefeed_reconcile' to confirm hourly delta < 0.1% after rollout.
Pick 10 random admin grant/revoke events and verify presence of assertion_id in audit index and the ability to map to a SAML assertion record.
Run the runbook play: simulate a missing event, trigger reingest, and confirm event appears in audit index within 2 hours.
Confirm retention-index entries for admin events include retention_class=admin_high_precision and have correct lifecycle timestamps.
Validate reduced alert noise: inspect PagerDuty alerts for auth-observability for past 14 days; false positives < 5%.
retrospective: This ticket is a cross-functional follow-up to recurring audit gaps. Early analysis suggests a mix of systemic ingestion fragility and insufficient metadata propagation from SAML connectors. The chosen path favors defensive recording (no sampling for admin events) plus automated reconciliation to minimize manual security investigations. We will measure success by delta reduction and by time-to-reconstruct for RM/SEC investigations.
